FX02.name: Depth Parallax Field
FX02.deviationJustification: C30 allows bounded pointer displacement on desktop hero only, but testing showed static optical framing provided cleaner typography contrast and zero distraction from primary Trust CTA

FX03.name: Prism Light Sweep
sections: Landing Hero Brand Badges and Buttons
FX03.reason: Signature spectral shimmer for Khai Minh brand identity

FX04.name: Knowledge Glass
FX04.technology: CSS backdrop-filter: blur(4px) to blur(8px) + rgba mineral border + opaque fallback
FX04.reason: Subtle academic glassmorphism with strict 4-8px blur ceiling to preserve readability

FX05.name: Editorial Scroll Choreography
FX05.deviationJustification: C58 mandates evaluating Cases timeline usability first. Normal archive UX proved significantly faster to scan and keyboard-navigate without sticky collision risks. Formally rejected per C58.

FX06.name: Discovery Markers
FX06.deviationJustification: Per C47, discovery markers require durable data binding. In the absence of live geospatial community nodes, static taxonomy tabs were used to prevent fabricating false community activity.

FX07.name: Ambient Optical Field
FX07.technology: Bounded 3-node SVG ambient drift with pointer:fine guard and reduced-motion disable
FX07.reason: Adds subtle academic wonder to landing hero without obscuring text or CTA
FX07.deviationJustification: Strictly limited to 3 SVG nodes per C31

FX08.name: Micro Precision Feedback
sections: Landing Hero Trust Engine CTA button
FX08.technology: Pointer-fine bounded spring (dx*0.12, dy*0.12, max 6px) + rAF
FX08.reason: Provides tactile precision feedback for primary conversion action
FX08.deviationJustification: Respects pointer:fine and disables on touch/reduced-motion

FX09.name: Evidence Prism Image Framing

FX09.technology: Aspect ratio preservation + subtle mineral gradient overlay + object-position focal anchors
FX09.reason: Core visual coherence primitive across all 7 routes

FX10.name: Noise-to-Knowledge Transition
